title: Bench usage
note: INSTRUMENTATION FOR A PRE-DECIDED KILL-CONDITION (card CQ-4, 2026-08-25). The bench's kill-condition is written down and dated: if after a month the bench's only user is the developer, the UI did not earn its build — keep Door A and retire the bench to the promptfoo CLI. A condition that is checked from memory is not a condition, so the page files one record per person per chain per day, and `bench_usage.py` answers the question from the records instead of from anyone's recollection. Item id = the person (declared identity, same as everywhere on this plane); one record per open, append-only. THIS KIND GATES NOTHING and is nobody's performance record — it counts opens of a page, and its only consumer is the retire-or-keep decision on 2026-09-25.

verdict_fields.note: `open` = somebody loaded the bench for a chain. `request` = somebody actually asked for a matrix — the stronger signal of the two, and the one the kill-condition turns on.
declared identity — the record's item id is the same name
which chain's bench was opened; absent when the picker itself was the whole visit (which is still a use, and still counted)
which viewer wrote it (X-Client), so a record can be traced to a surface
